the best method to recover blends is to use the method of least-squares fitting of a blend surface to a set of points, which are obtained by a combination of the method of best fitting of a blend to a set of triangles, and a method of best fitting a blend surface to an initial guess.

the best method of recovering constant radius rolling blends is the one that combines the best features of the three algorithms presented in this paper: (i) the algorithm of [4, 5] that uses the least number of points, (ii) the algorithm of this paper, which is the most robust and (iii) the algorithm of Kobbelt et al. [11], which is the fastest.

the best results are achieved by the following methods: (1) the method based on a combination of the least squares fitting and the method of moving least squares (LSF-MLS) and (2) the method based upon the method of moving average (MA) and the method of least squares (MA-LS) with a special treatment of the vertex blends.
